name: faberlang-agent-skills
description: Focused agent guides for the Faber Romanus programming language: install, the English reader spelling, packages, and corpus lookup.

skills.name: install
skills.description: Download and verify the current Faber CLI release for macOS arm64 or Linux x64.

skills.name: language
skills.description: Write Faber in the English reader spelling. Start at the agent canon and follow its links.

skills.name: packages
skills.description: Scaffold and drive Faber packages with the faber init manifest and faber check, build, run, test, and format.

skills.name: corpus
skills.description: Look up a keyword in the generated catalog after the writing guide.
